Project- The conversion of Scarabeo5 from a semisubmersible drilling rig unit into a Floating Production Unit (FPU) 

will be performed through the following construction main phases: 

Inspection, Refurbishment / Repair and Life Extension activities 

• 
•  Demolition / removal activities of all drilling equipment and modules defined by Engineering as demolition scope 

for Converting the SC5 into FPU   

•  Hull Conversion / Modifications, upgrade of the SC5  
•  Living Quarte renewal to increase the POB 
•  Topside Modules Fabrication  
•  Transportation and Integration of Topside Modules onto the SC5 
•  Mechanical Completion and Commissioning of the complete facilities 

Roles and Responsibility 

•  Oversaw  environmental  compliance  across  both  yard  (construction  and  Module  Fabrication),  ensuring 
consistency  with  both  corporate  and  local  regulatory  standards.  This  included  the  implementation  of 
environmental safeguards, monitoring adherence to legislative requirements, and the integration of sustainable 
practices throughout the project lifecycle. 

•  Assisted in and evaluated the contractor's development of the project Environmental Management Plan, Waste 

Management Plan, and Spill Prevention Plan for execution. 

•  Assess  the  waste  collection  contractor  to  ensure  adherence  to  waste  management  practices,  including  the 
handling, transportation, and disposal of waste materials. Confirm that the contractor possesses current permits 
and certifications as required by local authorities and verify their compliance with relevant regulations. 

•  Reviewing the contractor's monthly environmental report prior to submission to the corporate environment team. 
This report includes  information  on  waste  management, energy usage,  water  withdrawal  and  discharge,  spill 
incidents and near misses, and third-party invoices for the collection of general waste, hazardous waste, and 
wastewater from chemical cleaning or other activities. 

•  Collaborate with the HSE Manager and client representatives to address work site issues with contractors while 
ensuring adherence to local environmental regulations, company procedures, policies, and safe work practices. 
•  Engage in weekly and monthly HSE meetings involving the client, company, and contractor to identify areas for 

environmental improvement and propose best practices. 

•  Perform regular site inspections to ensure compliance with environmental standards. These assessments  cover 
various aspects such as waste management, correct labeling and storage of hazardous materials, effectiveness 
of  spill  response  procedures,  suitable  ventilation  and  lighting,  dust  control  measures  for  processes  like 
sandblasting, gauging, and grinding, as well as the handling of wastewater and sewage, while also safeguarding 
marine waters from contamination. 

•  Conducted environmental assessments at multiple sites, such as the Fabrication Workshop, Painting Workshop, 
Sand  Blasting  Workshop,  hazardous  waste  collection  area,  and  paint  storage  facility.  Evaluated  VOC 
concentrations and verified the efficiency of ventilation and filtration systems, along with the waste gas disposal 
techniques  employed  in  the  painting  workshop,  which  featured  filtration,  activated  carbon  desorption,  and 
catalytic combustion processes. 

•  Gather and evaluate quarterly inspection reports from third party regarding yard emissions. This encompasses 
unregulated gases, emissions from fixed sources, noise pollution, sewage discharge, and seawater quality. 
•  Maintain  all  documentation  pertaining  to  environmental  management  in  an  organized  and  easily  accessible 

manner, ensuring they meet the necessary standards for reporting and auditing purposes. 

•  Provided  training  sessions  for  staff  on  environmental  compliance  and  best  practices,  fostering  a  culture  that 

prioritizes sustainability. 

•  Execute corporate environmental initiatives, prepare reports, and share updates on awareness campaigns with 
the  corporate  team  on  a  quarterly  basis  for  occasions  such  as  World  Water  Day,  World  Environment  Day, 
European Mobility Week, and European Waste Reduction Week. 

•  Supervise and evaluate the environmental drills conducted in accordance with the environmental management 
plan. This plan includes emergency simulations for oil spills in Seawater and hazardous chemical leaks at storage 
facilities.  These  exercises  are  carefully  crafted  and  executed
